plan.notes: Source: Hudson Valley Community College official catalog, 'Program: Business Administration, A.S.' (Associate in Science, HEGIS 5004), 'Suggested Course Sequence for Full-Time Study' (catalog.hvcc.edu). Four terms transcribed exactly as published: 16+16+16+14 = 62, matching the published 'Total Credits Required: 62'. The current 2025-2026 catalog page for this program returned an upstream 403 on fetch, so catalog_year is honestly stamped 2024-2025 (newest successfully retrieved official sequence). FORM 104 College Forum is published as 1 credit but the catalog footnote states it 'Does not count towards degree total' (required of first-time full-time students; may be waived) — transcribed at 0 credits with required_zero:true so the sequence math matches the official term totals and degree total. Prerequisite ordering verified: ACTG 110 Financial Accounting (Term 2) before ACTG 111 Managerial Accounting (Term 3); ENGL 101 before ENGL 102/104; BADM 110 (Business Law I) before BADM 111 (Business Law II); ECON 100 before ECON 101 as published. Published choice slots: MATH 165 (Basic Calculus with Analytic Geometry) OR MATH 170 (Precalculus) OR MATH 180 (Calculus I); ENGL 102 OR ENGL 104 (ENGL 104 recommended for SUNY transfer); Computer Elective (any CMPT or CISS; CMPT 115 recommended); Natural Science Elective; General Education Electives (combined SUNY GE & LAS). Degree classification: AS = transfer-oriented associate (university-parallel program per catalog).
